CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Richmond District at 9:00AM. Robert will be at Chinatown from 7:45AM to 5:30PM. You'd like to meet Robert for a minimum of 120 minutes. David will be at Sunset District from 12:30PM to 7:45PM. You'd like to meet David for a minimum of 45 minutes. Matthew will be at Alamo Square from 8:45AM to 1:45PM. You'd like to meet Matthew for a minimum of 90 minutes. Jessica will be at Financial District from 9:30AM to 6:45PM. You'd like to meet Jessica for a minimum of 45 minutes. Melissa will be at North Beach from 7:15AM to 4:45PM. You'd like to meet Melissa for a minimum of 45 minutes. Mark will be at Embarcadero from 3:15PM to 5:00PM. You'd like to meet Mark for a minimum of 45 minutes. Deborah will be at Presidio from 7:00PM to 7:45PM. You'd like to meet Deborah for a minimum of 45 minutes. Karen will be at Golden Gate Park from 7:30PM to 10:00PM. You'd like to meet Karen for a minimum of 120 minutes. Laura will be at Bayview from 9:15PM to 10:15PM. You'd like to meet Laura for a minimum of 15 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
Below is one optimal itinerary that meets eight friends (Matthew, Robert, Melissa, Jessica, Mark, David, Karen and Laura) in an order that “flows” geographically and temporally. (Because the evening‐time commitments conflict with one another, it turns out that meeting all nine friends isn’t possible. In this solution the Presidio bound meeting with Deborah is skipped so that the long 2‑hour meeting with Karen and the short meeting with Laura can both be accommodated.)

The schedule is as follows (all times “HH:MM” are in 24‑hour notation):

1. You begin at Richmond District at 09:00 and immediately travel 13 minutes to Alamo Square.
  • Meet Matthew (at Alamo Square, available 08:45–13:45) for 90 minutes from 09:15 to 10:45.
2. Leave Alamo Square; a 15‑minute trip takes you to Chinatown.
  • Meet Robert (in Chinatown, available 07:45–17:30) for 120 minutes from 11:00 to 13:00.
3. Depart Chinatown (3‑minute ride) and head to North Beach.
  • Meet Melissa (at North Beach, available 07:15–16:45) for 45 minutes from 13:05 to 13:50.
4. From North Beach, an 8‑minute trip brings you to the Financial District.
  • Meet Jessica (in Financial District, available 09:30–18:45) for 45 minutes from 14:00 to 14:45.
5. Next, travel 4 minutes from Financial District to Embarcadero. Although you arrive around 14:49, Mark’s availability in the Embarcadero starts at 15:15.
  • Meet Mark (at Embarcadero, available 15:15–17:00) for 45 minutes from 15:15 to 16:00.
6. Depart Embarcadero and take a 30‑minute ride to Sunset District.
  • Meet David (at Sunset District, available 12:30–19:45) for 45 minutes from 16:30 to 17:15.
7. From Sunset District, travel 11 minutes to Golden Gate Park. Although you arrive around 17:26, Karen isn’t available until 19:30.
  • At 19:30, begin meeting Karen (in Golden Gate Park, available 19:30–22:00) for 120 minutes until 21:30.
8. Finally, depart Golden Gate Park and take a 23‑minute trip to Bayview.
  • Meet Laura (at Bayview, available 21:15–22:15) for 15 minutes from 21:53 to 22:08.

Each meeting exactly meets the minimum required meeting duration while respecting travel and the friend’s availability. This itinerary maximizes the number of friends met (8 of 9) given the constraints.

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Matthew", "start_time": "09:15", "end_time": "10:45"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Robert", "start_time": "11:00", "end_time": "13:00"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Melissa", "start_time": "13:05", "end_time": "13:50"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Jessica", "start_time": "14:00", "end_time": "14:45"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Mark", "start_time": "15:15", "end_time": "16:00"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "David", "start_time": "16:30", "end_time": "17:15"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Karen", "start_time": "19:30", "end_time": "21:30"},
    {"action": "meet", "person": "Laura", "start_time": "21:53", "end_time": "22:08"}
  ]
}

This schedule assumes that—with travel in between—you wait when necessary to meet each friend within their available window. (Deborah, who is available at Presidio from 19:00 to 19:45, was not included because adding her would force Karen’s meeting to run too late to allow a timely 15‑minute session with Laura.)
